'''Dej Vennor''' was a [[Death/Legends|deadly]] and proficient [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Vennor accepted only [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] that targeted [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. He was rumored to be a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]], as he wore a set of modified [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|scout trooper armor]]. Vennor owned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Target Acquired]]'', a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray''-31-class patrol and attack craft]], as well as [[IT-904]], an [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], Dej Vennor became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Efficient and [[Death/Legends|deadly]], Vennor only took [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] assignments on [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and refused contracts dealing with [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] or [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], unless they had taken part in piracy. Many rumors at that [[Time/Legends|time]] focused on Vennor's background, with some stating that he was a former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]], while others said that a pirate [[King/Legends|king]] had badly scarred him. Rumors also claimed that Vennor's family had been completely killed by a pirate raid, while some stated that Vennor tracked pirates to their lairs to steal their treasures.<ref name="Orbit" />

At one point Vennor purchased [[IT-904]], a former Imperial [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]], from [[The Most Honourable Guild of Armourers]] via an auction on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Epsi Nadir]]. Vennor later extensively modified the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The bounty hunter also owned the modified [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray''-31-class patrol and attack craft]] ''[[Target Acquired]]''.<ref name="Orbit" />

{{RPGseed}}
In 0 ABY, Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vocis Kenit]], formerly of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'', placed bounties on the heads of his former crew after they [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|mutinied]] and seized the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] from him. Vennor attempted to go after those bounties and tracked the ''Far Orbit''.<ref name="Orbit" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
A skilled bounty hunter, Vennor only took bounties on pirates and refused to go after non-pirates.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Equipment==
Vennor wore a modified version of Imperial [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|scout trooper armor]], which had a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and a sealed [[enviro filter]] that could block out gases and [[Poison/Legends|toxins]] for up to two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], as well as protect him from the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The [[Armor/Legends|armor]] also had [[Limb/Legends|wrist]] [[Laser/Legends|lasers]], an internal-line slinger tipped with a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] or [[Magnetic grapple|magnetic]] point, and was coated with a substance called [[Reflec/Legends|reflec]], which prohibited [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Vennor owned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''Target Acquired'', and armed himself with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]], a [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]], and a [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenade]]. Vennor additionally owned three pairs of [[Binders/Legends|binders]].<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dej Vennor was first mentioned in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the ''Far Orbit''{{'s}} adventures. In ''The Far Orbit Project'', Vennor appears in the scenario hook "The Price of Success," which allows players the option to have the bounty hunter appear in their missions as opposition to the crew of the ''Far Orbit''.<ref name="Orbit" />
